program.name: Ground-Up Balance
program.subject: Balance & stability
program.blurb: Balance from the ground up: feet and ankles, then knees and hips.
program.about: Balance that starts at the feet. One day trains the feet, ankles and calves with raises, walks and holds; the other the knees and hips with step-ups, reaches and airplanes. They alternate. Abs finish every session. Both later levels add reps.
